g.text: BrewLite — Sơ đồ Triển khai Hệ thống (Monochrome UML Deployment Diagram)
Security: Không public Port 5432 DB & Port 3001 nội bộ
ci.yml (PR/develop): postgres:16-alpine, lint, prisma push, seed, Jest Unit & test:e2e, build
cd.yml (main/v*.*.*): Quality Gate -> Build Images -> prisma validate/migrate deploy -> Deploy Hook -> Smoke Test
Quét QR trên Camera điện thoại
CMD: prisma db push -> seed -> node
GET /api/health & /health (200 OK, SELECT 1 + Uptime + Version JSON)
(MVP hiện dùng MockGatewayService nội bộ trong PaymentModule)
hoặc npm run docker:all + scripts/tunnel.js / https-proxy.js (:3443)
